{{Quote|We had some calibration issues and had to make a maintenance stop on Korasa. In fact, our weight is ''still'' a little off. It's almost like we're&mdash;''over-burdened!''<nowiki></nowiki>|translated=1|Nub Jakkak in [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustese]]|<ref name="Mandalorian Memories">{{TCWComicCite|6.41|Mandalorian Memories}}</ref>}}
'''Nub Jakkak''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jakkak journeyed to [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] aboard his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. En-route, Jakkak stopped over on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Korasa]] to perform maintenance to the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] and unknown to him, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]] [[Korasa job|boarded]] the roof of his vessel. When Jakkak docked his ship in Timira [[City/Legends|City]], the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] jumped down and attacked Jakkak and some of the facility's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] guards. Bossk picked Jakkak up and tossed him away, causing Jakkak to collide with the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Seeker (clone trooper)|Seeker]].
